status: Retrospective sensitivity protocol fixed before this extension was computed; not prospective registration

measurement.unit: Eleven author-mapped DFU patients, seven healed and four not healed
measurement.threshold_free: Supremum absolute difference between group means of patient-normalized empirical CDFs, evaluated over every observed fibroblast loading; all 330 patient label allocations including ties
measurement.grid_multiplicity: Max statistic across the entire empirical CDF support, not selection of an outcome-favorable cut
measurement.cell_count_sensitivity: 250 draws of 100 fibroblasts without replacement per DFU specimen; average equally across specimens within patient; same eleven patients and frozen representation; seed 29
measurement.repeat_sampling: Enumerate all choices of one specimen per patient; report contrast and exhaustive-probability ranges for all three readouts

historical_reports: Read-only; write new CSVs and reports to outputs/computational_extension
